name: Wife of Hodiah
title: Jewish woman in the genealogy
summary: The wife of Hodiah, sister of Naham, is mentioned in the genealogy of Judah as the mother of the clans associated with Keilah and Maacah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
